pricing_scenarios.scope: Common catalog price scenarios applied to every observed workload, not endpoint-matched invoices, minimum provider quotes, or historical charges. No account identity or route inferred from aliases.

protocol: Usage and per-request latency come from immutable logs, including invalid responses. No billed dollar cost is recorded. Cost formula: (input_tokens * input_USD_per_M + output_tokens * output_USD_per_M)/1e6. The 1/5 USD-per-million column is an explicitly hypothetical price scenario, not an invoice or verified vendor rate; no cached-input discount assumed. Enrollment and subsequent query costs are separate. Timestamps are completion times and collection spans include scheduling and retry gaps. Concurrency estimates replay recorded request durations in deterministic list order on ideal c workers, assuming duration independence and zero dispatch overhead; these are not measured concurrent audit wall times.
